unstuck_said.text: Filed issue noobshole/svalin-agent#1: "A Nano (XNO) pay rail beside USDC — the deterministic risk report gets a feeless self-verifying receipt". Framed in their own terms — Svalin is deterministic read-only risk intelligence (same holdings same report, public versioned methodology), paid per call in USDC/x402. A Nano block is the self-verifying payment receipt, feeless, no facilitator. Proposed nano:mainnet accepts[] scheme + block hash as per-call receipt. No machine signature.
